doc.title: Noa Tournoy — software engineering, data and security
doc.desc: Noa Tournoy, engineering student in Lille, France. Software, data and cybersecurity. Six works, from a Looker security dashboard to the procedural 3D web experience Éclosion.
id: Software engineering student. Development, data, security. Joining ADEO as a cybersecurity apprentice on 1 October 2026.
decl: I build software that holds up and stays secure.
decl.1: Engineering student at SUPINFO, in Lille. In the summer of 2025 at ADEO I built DataSentinel: a dashboard that replaced the manual tracking of digital-product security, along with the full-stack extensions around it. The following summer, at Never2Wait, I worked on product development. I return to ADEO as a cybersecurity apprentice on 1 October 2026.
decl.2: The rest of the time I write C++ for the constraint, Python for how fast it lets me try things, and shaders for Éclosion — a fully procedural 3D web experience where scrolling is time.
p1.n: Passed with honours. Mathematics and computer science majors.
p2.n: One week. The front end of an HR management site in HTML and CSS, built from the designer's mockups.
p3.t: Master of EngineeringSUPINFO International University
p4.n: June to August. Looker and LookML, full-stack Python and React extensions, BigQuery, Terraform, Kubernetes. Google Looker and LookML certifications obtained.
p45.n: June to August. Python, TypeScript, React and Next.js, React Native.
w1: TypeScript · Next.js · React Three Fiber · GLSL. A fully procedural 3D web experience in eight acts
w2: LookML · Python · React · BigQuery · Terraform · Kubernetes. Digital-product security monitoring, at ADEO
w3: Godot 4.6 · C++20 · binary TCP. Multiplayer real-time strategy, authoritative server
